theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (h : UpperHalfPlane → ℂ) (E : UpperHalfPlane → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)), HeckeEis.IsEichlerIntegral n h E → DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -z) (E (UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex z)).val) {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im}
theorems.natural_summary: Homogeneity expands the evaluation into a fixed finite sum of degree-n coefficients multiplied by powers of −z. IsEichlerIntegral supplies differentiability of each coefficient on the upper half-plane; products and finite sums give the conclusion, including n = 0, without regularity assumptions on h.
